caveats: NIFTY daily Adj-Close log returns + India VIX close, vault only. c1-c4: pure contemporaneous correlation VIX_t vs RV_fwd_h(t), common sample bound by the h=63 horizon (n=3114, 2010-07-23..2023-04-05) so the 4 horizons are compared on identical dates; no fitting/state so no lookahead exposure (fwd RV is an evaluation target only). c5: HV_21_trail(t) uses only r[t-21:t] (data <= t); IV-HV spread percentile is expanding, min_obs=252 (no lookahead); monthly entries = first common NIFTY/VIX day per calendar month needing 21 fwd NIFTY days, OP-D1/F05 convention exactly (n=142, 2011-07-01..2023-04-03); VRP_t = VIX_t - RV_fwd_21(t). Sample bounded by the India VIX vault window (2010-07..2023-04); survivorship/mirror caveats n/a (index-level VIX+NIFTY only, no panel used).
